name: Mavrovo National Park in a day
description_md:
The Mavrovo National Park in a day is a waymarked hiking route located in MK. This trail covers a distance of 13.1 km with a walking time of about 5.7 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is situated within the borders of MK. It follows a waymarked path for the duration of the 13.1 km trek.
